channel.title: The Daily Digest
channel.description: One top story from each of my chosen publications, updated daily.

item.title: NYT: Trump Threatens Annihilation in Iran in UN Speech and Lays Out Winner-Takes-All Vision
item.description: President Trump’s speech at the U.N. General Assembly amounted to a rejection of the founding concept of the United Nations.

item.title: NPR: It's getting harder to afford rent in the U.S., even for middle-income families
item.description: Housing affordability challenges are spreading to higher income brackets, according to new research, which found one in five renters struggled last year to pay for their housing in full and on time.

item.title: BBC News: UK to review Chagos Islands deal over lack of US support, Streeting tells BBC
item.description: Defence Secretary Wes Streeting has confirmed the review after Donald Trump told Andy Burnham the deal was "terrible".

item.title: The Guardian: ‘This is where I live now, the back of a truck’: a day in the life of a grandmother in Gaza
item.description: As the war in Gaza approaches its fourth year, the Guardian follows five ordinary Palestinians as they go about their lives. Each tells the story of their day, revealing the terrible toll of the conflict. At 76, Mansoura…

item.title: Al Jazeera: How much is UK supporting Saudi Arabia in its war with Iran-backed Houthis?
item.description: UK to refuel Saudi fighter jets and France to secure energy infrastructure amid fighting with Yemen's Houthi group.

item.title: Ars Technica: America gave up its rare earth edge. China took full advantage.
item.description: Decades of cheaper imports left US dependent on China for crucial rare earth processing.

item.title: WIRED Backchannel: She’s 28, Loves God and Her Family, and Might Be the Reason You Can’t Have Kids
item.description: No IVF. No surrogacy. No polygenic tests. Emma Waters is leading a national fight against fertility tech—with her hot husband’s permission, of course.

item.title: WIRED Science: A Startup Wants to Power Data Centers With ‘Supercritical’ Carbon Dioxide
item.description: The technology could strap onto existing gas turbines and make them more efficient—but it wouldn’t do away with their emissions entirely.

item.title: WIRED Business: AT&T Is Automating Away Jobs—and Its Old Telecom Empire
item.description: The telecom giant is eager to show Wall Street that it can do more with less. That means fewer employees, less electricity, and increased automation.

item.title: The New Yorker: Is Trump’s Latest Press Attack Just Another Distraction?
item.description: After CNN, MS NOW, and Politico were barred from the White House, the entire TV press pool announced a boycott of the President.

item.title: New York Mag The Cut: Taylor Swift Is Releasing Even More Music
item.description: She’s dropping four new The Life of a Showgirl songs on Friday.

item.title: New York Mag Curbed: The Secret Lives of Subways
item.description: In a new exhibition, Christopher Payne documents the hidden parts of the city’s transit system.

item.title: Fox59: Man critically hurt after being struck by vehicle
item.description: INDIANAPOLIS – A man was critically hurt after being hit by a vehicle on the near east side. According to the Indianapolis Metropolitan Police Department, emergency responders were dispatched around 6:50 a.m. Wednesday t…

item.title: Mirror Indy: An Indianapolis church turned an AR-15 into a garden tool
item.description: The rifle was among two dozen guns forged into something new at “Guns to Gardens” last weekend. The post An Indianapolis church turned an AR-15 into a garden tool appeared first on Mirror Indy .
